author: agc123
quote: A little rough around the edges but nails the atmosphere and finally getting to play as Michael has been extremely fun. The dev team has poured a lot of love into the game so excited where it stands a year from now!

author: agc123
quote: Unbelievably disappointed, after such a long wait for extraordinary missions and character stories all we got was a Sims real life chore simulator. I realized today after going to the gym and taking out the trash that's the same **** the game has me doing. I didn't buy a game to do chores, if I could refund it I would. Graphics are great but who cares when the game is extraordinarily boring.
